# Workout Forge

> Workout Forge is a free, local-first workout planner and training log that runs in the browser and installs as an app (PWA). It builds a training block, logs every set, and sets the next session's targets from how the last one went. No account, no subscription, and it works offline.

## What it does

- Plans 2-, 3- or 4-day weeks in 4-, 6-, 8- or 12-week blocks, with a deload week at the end of each block. Start from a ready-made split or pick every exercise yourself.
- Logs weight and reps set by set. Each set saves on the device, with or without a connection.
- Sets the next session's weight, reps and sets from reps in reserve (RIR) and your soreness, effort and pump answers, and backs off the weight after two stalled sessions.
- Includes a plate calculator that shows what to load on each side of the bar.

## Data and pricing

- Free. There is no paid tier and no subscription.
- Your data is stored in the browser, on your device. An optional account backs it up and syncs it across devices.

## Status

- Early access, built in public. Features ship from user feedback.

## Links

- App: https://workoutforge.app/
